rationale: All 5 acceptance criteria pass per the acceptance lens. Blind + edge-case lenses raised real but non-blocking observations: fire-and-forget reconciliation, discarded {reconciled,failed} resolution value, debug-only failure logging, and no cross-session concurrency lock are all unmodified, inherited characteristics of reconcileStaleSessions already running in production for codex/pi — this fix explicitly scoped itself to reuse that utility as-is, so extending its call sites to 6 more plugins doesn't introduce a new defect class (2 deferred). A claude-specific env-mutation race (beforeRun's model-tier resolution could rewrite env.CODEMIE_MODEL while a pending reconcile closure reads it) is real but narrow, with worst-case impact limited to a cosmetic wrong model field on an unrelated stale session's synthetic finalization record (1 deferred). Duplicated buildXHookConfig helpers across claude/gemini/kimi match the project's existing per-plugin convention, not a regression (1 deferred). The blind lens's 'no synchronous-throw protection' claim is a false positive, refuted by JS semantics: reconcileStaleSessions is itself declared async, so any internal throw (including from buildXHookConfig, invoked inside it) auto-converts to a promise rejection already caught by .catch() (1 dismissed). kimi.plugin.ts's import-between-imports placement is valid syntax, confirmed non-blocking by this project's own eslint --max-warnings=0 and tsc --noEmit gates passing clean on every commit (1 dismissed, cosmetic). All pre-existing tests pass except 12 pre-existing failures across 4 unrelated files, confirmed identical on a clean origin/main checkout.
